scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Poor & Needy Widow Women
other_conditions: Must be a domicile of the state of Manipur
Must have continuously resided in Manipur for more than 5 years prior to the date of application
Application must be submitted through the respective District Social Welfare Officer
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 per annum per eligible widow, renewable each year subject to fund availability.
